name: lunaris-video
description: Graphics timeline for the LUNARIS presentation video (Remotion).

scripts.prep: node scripts/fetch-fonts.js && node scripts/copy-assets.js && node scripts/extract-diagram.js && node scripts/build-data.js && node scripts/capture.js
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Graphics out/graphics-1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --muted --timeout 180000 --concurrency 3
scripts.animatic: remotion render src/index.ts Animatic out/animatic-720p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 26 --scale 0.6666666666666666 --muted --timeout 180000 --concurrency 3
